core_features: The world is in the process of ending or collapsing during the story
Events are large-scale and catastrophic, not just local personal issues
Characters act under extreme time pressure and existential stakes
typical_settings: Cities in mid-collapse, global disasters unfolding
Places where the scale of destruction is visible
typical_conflicts: Attempting to prevent or mitigate the apocalypse
Choosing who/what can be saved under impossible constraints
Moral choices under extreme global pressure
protagonist_archetypes: Scientists, leaders, soldiers, or ordinary people thrown into critical roles
People torn between saving loved ones and saving many
tone_guidelines: Intense, high-stakes, often tragic or bittersweet.

required_elements: Clear description of what the apocalypse is (plague, invasion, cosmic event, etc.)
A sense that time is running out
Decisions whose consequences affect more than just the protagonist
forbidden_elements: Tiny personal drama with no connection to the larger catastrophic context
